data.long_description:
Experience the epitome of modern luxury living at Burj Royale, Downtown Dubai. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment spans 959.06 sq. ft., offering a refined blend of comfort, style, and sophistication. Designed with contemporary finishes and floor-to-ceiling windows, the apartment is filled with natural light and offers breathtaking views of the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain.

The open-plan living and dining area flows seamlessly into a fully equipped modern kitchen, creating the perfect space for relaxation and entertaining. Both bedrooms are elegantly designed with built-in wardrobes and premium fittings, while the bathrooms feature sleek, high-quality finishes.

Property Features:

• Size: 959.06 sq. ft.
• 2 Bedrooms, 2 Bathrooms
• Fully fitted modern kitchen
• Floor-to-ceiling windows with Burj Khalifa views
• Bright and spacious living area
• High-end finishes throughout

Building Amenities:

• Infinity pool overlooking Burj Khalifa
• Fully equipped gym
• Dedicated covered parking
• 24/7 security and concierge services
• Children’s play area and landscaped leisure deck

Located just steps away from Dubai Mall and Downtown Boulevard, Burj Royale offers the perfect balance of urban convenience and elegant living — a true statement address in the heart of Dubai.
data.title: 2 bedroom apartment to rent
